# relay_api_key (Data Source)

Reads an existing organization or workspace API key by ID or name. The secret is never readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_api_key" "deployer" {
  name         = "deployer"
  workspace_id = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) API key ID.
- `name` (String) API key name. Must match exactly one key.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in. Omit it for organization keys.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) CIDR blocks the key may be used from; empty allows any address.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry, RFC 3339. Null when the key never expires.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last use, RFC 3339. Null when never used.
- `parent_key_id` (String) ID of the API key that created this one, empty when a user did.
- `role` (String) Role slug granted to the key.
